text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report outlines the results of our investigation into installing speed humps on Arrowsmith Avenue, between Keele Street and Amesbury Drive. The results indicate that the criteria to justify installing speed humps are not satisfied.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Did NOT approve installing speed humps on Arrowsmith Avenue.
